create_label_smoothed_loss: create a LabelSmoothedCrossEntropyLoss module with smoothing epsilon and padding index for NMT training
compute_nll_loss: compute negative log-likelihood loss from log-probabilities and target indices using gather operation
compute_smooth_loss: compute uniform distribution smoothing loss by summing negative log-probabilities across all classes
apply_padding_mask: apply padding mask to exclude padding token positions from both nll_loss and smooth_loss computations
combine_loss_components: combine nll_loss and smooth_loss using epsilon weighting to produce final label-smoothed cross-entropy loss
